official_task_documentation.description: There are several number tiles on the table and a pad for placement. The robot needs to determine the order that forms the largest possible number, then place the four numbers on the pad from left to right in that order.
official_task_documentation.comment: Each digit must remain within the permitted rotational tolerance relative to its initial pose.

scoring.condition: Any one digit is placed on its correct pad in descending-number order, with valid orientation and the gripper open.
Any two digits are correctly placed.
In a 5-digit layout, any three digits are correctly placed.
In a 4-digit layout, any three digits are correctly placed.
In a 5-digit layout, any four digits are correctly placed.
All digits are correctly ordered on the pads, have valid orientation, and the robot returns to origin.
